name: Tethra

attributes.attribute: called the fairy king of the Otherworld
member of the Tuatha De Danann

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Tethra is an Irish hero. The text gives him the title of fairy king of the Otherworld. Scholars know almost nothing else about him. The record names his people, the Tuatha De Danann. That place of honor is all the legend leaves behind.

okr.objective: Record Tethra as an obscure fairy king of the Otherworld.
